findings.title: A provider closed during COMMIT/lease completion can still return accepted output
findings.rootCause: assertOpen guards entry, queued lease and pre-SQL/pre-COMMIT, but no lifecycle assertion runs after await COMMIT, after await withLease, or at the final public read/execute/recover return boundary. Closing after the callback has committed but before withLease resolves therefore escapes the selected provider close fence. The existing provider Person and MemberClaim methods perform an await-result/guard-return check, so this is a concrete missing lifecycle edge rather than a new Auth policy.
findings.reproduction: A mock existing withLease awaits the real port callback (including successful COMMIT), sets its lifecycle open=false, then returns that callback result. Port.execute resolves the validated APPLIED receipt envelope instead of rejecting closed. Author source/test unchanged; probe is one appended case in a temporary copy with absolute author-source imports.
findings.minimalDelta: Add lifecycle checks after the final awaited result at the public typed-method boundary, covering COMMIT and whole lease completion. Keep existing early/precommit checks so closure before commit rolls back. If COMMIT already succeeded, do not pretend ROLLBACK removes the effect: propagate sanitized runtime-closed/unavailable, preserve original operation/digest/receipt and require original read-only recovery; never retry/replay. Preserve optional default-noop direct factory compatibility and same existing connection/SQL authority. This can be implemented in the current factory or a minimal typed existing-provider wrapper, without new environment flag/connection/raw DB export/framework.
findings.focusedAcceptance: Keep46. Add closure during successful COMMIT and after callback-before-lease-return cases for public execute/read/recover, showing no accepted return once the selected runtime is closed. Precommit closure still rolls back; after successful commit no false rollback/no resubmit, original-operation recovery on qualified fresh runtime remains available.
